prompt: What is the reference angle for $-120^\circ$? Give just the number of degrees.
hint: Turn it into a positive coterminal angle first: $-120 + 360$.

hints.text: Turn it into a positive coterminal angle first: $-120 + 360$.
That gives $240^\circ$, which is in Quadrant III.

explanation: Add a full turn to get a positive angle in the same place: $-120^\circ + 360^\circ = 240^\circ$.
$240^\circ$ lies in Quadrant III, between $180^\circ$ and $270^\circ$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Rotate clockwise and look
steps: Turning $120^\circ$ clockwise from the positive $x$-axis takes you past straight down ($-90^\circ$) and $30^\circ$ further.
That lands down and to the left, in Quadrant III, tilted $60^\circ$ from the horizontal axis.
